about: The default prayer-time method of each country (P2-D1), as data shared by the web, Android and iPhone (prayer-methods.md, 'Rules this sets for the clients'). Every method except the fallback was read from its official body's own timetable — see prayer-methods.md for the source, the days read and the measured values. A country not listed uses the fallback, and the screen says so. Adding a country is a change to this file only. The clients build each method from these values (angles, interval, minutes) — not from the Adhan library's presets, which add a minute to Dhuhr for some methods that the official timetables do not show.

MWL.source: Muslim World League — the fallback where no official timetable has been read

Egypt.source: Egyptian General Authority of Survey, as published by Dar al-Ifta — https://www.dar-alifta.org/ar/prayer-times, read 2026-11-22

Turkey.source: Diyanet İşleri Başkanlığı — https://namazvakitleri.diyanet.gov.tr, all of 2026 read

Malaysia.source: JAKIM e-Solat (zone WLY01), all of 2026 read: 18° for both, each published about two minutes after the 18° moment; Dhuhr +2.8 and Maghrib +1.9 minutes, rounded. Not the library's 20° Singapore preset.

Singapore.source: MUIS — its timetable on data.gov.sg, all of 2025 read

timeZones.about: The device's IANA time zone suggests its country when no city is chosen (read on the device, never sent anywhere). Only the zones of the countries above.
